panels.title: Pageviews / unique visitors / sessions per hour

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfHour(occurred_at) AS t, countIf(event_type='page_view') AS pageviews, uniqExact(anonymous_id) AS visitors, uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions FROM analytics.clickstream WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

SELECT uniqExact(anonymous_id) AS visitors, uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions, count() AS events, round(count() / greatest(uniqExact(session_id), 1), 1) AS events_per_session FROM analytics.clickstream WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
SELECT event_type, count() AS events FROM analytics.clickstream WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY events DESC

SELECT countIf(event_type='product_view') AS product_views, countIf(event_type='add_to_cart') AS add_to_cart, countIf(event_type='begin_checkout') AS begin_checkout, countIf(event_type='purchase') AS purchase, round(100 * countIf(event_type='purchase') / greatest(countIf(event_type='product_view'), 1), 2) AS view_to_purchase_pct FROM analytics.clickstream WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

SELECT product_id, count() AS views, uniqExact(anonymous_id) AS visitors FROM analytics.clickstream WHERE event_type='product_view' AND product_id != '' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT path, count() AS pageviews, uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions FROM analytics.clickstream WHERE event_type='page_view' AND path != '' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY path ORDER BY pageviews DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT query, count() AS searches, uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions FROM analytics.clickstream WHERE event_type='search' AND query != '' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY query ORDER BY searches DESC LIMIT 20
